snippet.title: "Tsugunohi -The Chamber of Phantom Name-" PV for PlayStation®4
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015512
■Release date: April 16, 2026 at 12:00 a.m.(*Subject to change slightly.)
■Languages: Japanese/English/Simplified Chinese

■ABOUT THIS GAME
The well-known everyday horror game Tsugunohi, where you simply walk to the left, brings The Chamber of Phantom Name to Nintendo Switch and PS4!
The basic gameplay remains the same as previous entries in the Tsugunohi series—just press the left key “←” to move the protagonist to the left.
With no complex controls, players can fully immerse themselves in the eerie yet realistic stories crafted by creator ImCyan.
In addition, this installment introduces, for the first time in the Tsugunohi series, brutal “gore” expressions.
Can you withstand the even more refined horror direction?
Experience the further evolved terror of Tsugunohi, brought to you by ImCyan.

■STORY
Kana Sakuragi, a young professional, begins her new life in “Akembara House,” a renovated old residence.
At first glance, it appears to be a bright and desirable property, but every night, she is confronted with strange phenomena inside the house.

A suspicious caretaker, mysterious ghost characters of unknown origin, and unsettling origami figures—
Is this reality, or…?
-----------------------—

■“Tsugunohi” series
ImCyan is an indie game creator who has created a number of horror titles. “Tsugunohi” is one of his best-known works.
Tsugunohi” series is characterized by its unique horror experience. As you repeatedly “walk to the left” on your usual way home or to your workplace, your daily life will eventually become distorted and a deep sense of fear will envelop you.
Please enjoy the horror as your daily life gradually changes into something more disturbing.

Official website ▶ https://www.gamemaga.jp/tsugunohi/
Official X website ▶ https://x.com/tsugunohi

©ImCyan/Vaka, Inc.
